segments.name: Engineered Stone and Other Materials Surfaces
segments.description: Design, produce and resell engineered stone, natural stone and porcelain surfaces for countertops, vanities and other interior and exterior applications globally.
segments.evidence: The Company manages its business on the basis of one operating segment and derives revenues mainly from the sale of high quality engineered stone and other materials surfaces.

revenueModel.text: Wholesale sales to fabricators and distributors of engineered stone, porcelain and natural stone slabs for countertops and other interior and exterior applications.
revenueModel.evidence: The majority of our sales are at the wholesale level of fabricators and distributors and exclude fabrication, installation and other service-related costs.

changes.text: Since 2023, discontinued production operations in Sdot-Yam Israel, Bar-Lev Israel and Richmond Hill Georgia facilities as part of manufacturing restructuring.
changes.evidence: Since 2023, our manufacturing network has been undergoing restructuring, with the focus of optimizing our global production footprint. As part of this strategic plan, we shifted our focus from in-house production activities and discontinued production operations in our Sdot-Yam, Israel, Bar-Lev, Israel and Richmond Hill, GA, USA, production facilities.
